```{r rt-data-processing}

# the Rt tab estimates from a file of its own, or from the file already loaded on
# the incubation period or serial interval tab, so one outbreak dataset can serve
# all three analyses
rt_file <- reactive({
  src <- input$rt_source
  f <- switch(src,
              inc    = input$file1_inc,
              si     = input$file1_si,
              upload = input$file1_rt)
  req(f)
  d <- read.csv(f$datapath[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  d <- data.frame(lapply(d, trimws), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  clean_names(d)
})

# every row, with the onset date as the app read it and a note of what became of
# the row. the incubation and serial interval files call the column date_of_onset,
# the mock data calls it date_onset; both are accepted.
rt_checked <- reactive({
  d <- rt_file()
  col <- intersect(c("date_of_onset", "date_onset"), names(d))[1]
  validate(need(!is.na(col),
    "incorrect dataset: the Rt tab needs a 'date of onset' (or 'date onset') column."))
  raw   <- as.character(d[[col]])
  blank <- is.na(raw) | !nzchar(trimws(raw)) |
           toupper(trimws(raw)) %in% c("NA", "N/A", "NULL", "-", "ASYMPTOMATIC")
  d$onset_as_given <- raw
  d$onset_read     <- parse_date(raw)
  d$status <- dplyr::case_when(
    blank               ~ "excluded: no onset date given",
    is.na(d$onset_read) ~ "excluded: onset date could not be read",
    TRUE                ~ "used"
  )
  d
})

# daily incidence by date of onset, with the days that had no case filled in as zero
rt_incidence <- reactive({
  d <- rt_checked()
  dates <- d$onset_read[d$status == "used"]
  validate(need(length(dates) > 0, "no usable onset dates in this file."))
  inc <- tibble::tibble(dates = dates) %>%
    dplyr::count(dates, name = "I") %>%
    tidyr::complete(dates = seq(min(dates), max(dates), by = "day"), fill = list(I = 0))
  as.data.frame(inc)
})

# the serial interval behind the estimate: the fit already made on the serial
# interval tab, as the reviewer asked, or a mean and sd typed in by the user
rt_si <- reactive({
  if (identical(input$rt_si_source, "manual")) {
    return(list(label = "entered by hand", mean = input$rt_mean_si, sd = input$rt_std_si))
  }
  req(input$file1_si)
  res <- fit_results_si()
  validate(need(!is.null(res) && length(res) > 0,
    "the Serial Interval tab could not fit a model to its data, so there is no estimate to use."))
  # the model chosen on that tab; when it shows all of them, the best fit by AIC
  by_aic <- length(res) > 1
  best <- if (!by_aic) res[[1]] else
    res[[which.min(vapply(res, function(x) x$aic, numeric(1)))]]
  list(label = paste0(tools::toTitleCase(tolower(best$model)), " fit",
                      if (by_aic) " (lowest AIC)" else "", ", Serial Interval tab"),
       mean  = unname(best$moments["mean"]),
       sd    = sqrt(unname(best$moments["var"])))
})

# Rt by the method of Cori et al. (2013): EpiEstim with a parametric serial interval
rt_result <- reactive({
  inc <- rt_incidence()
  si  <- rt_si()
  w   <- input$rt_window
  validate(
    need(is.numeric(si$mean) && length(si$mean) == 1 && is.finite(si$mean) && si$mean > 1,
         sprintf("the method of Cori et al. needs a mean serial interval above 1 day; the value in use is %s.",
                 format(round(as.numeric(si$mean), 2)))),
    need(is.numeric(si$sd) && length(si$sd) == 1 && is.finite(si$sd) && si$sd > 0,
         "the standard deviation of the serial interval must be above 0."),
    need(nrow(inc) >= w + 1,
         sprintf("a %d-day window needs at least %d days of incidence, and this data covers %d. Shorten the window or use a longer series.",
                 w, w + 1, nrow(inc)))
  )
  # windows of w days sliding one day at a time, starting on day 2 as EpiEstim requires
  t_start <- seq(2, nrow(inc) - w + 1)
  t_end   <- t_start + w - 1
  warn <- character(0)
  res <- withCallingHandlers(
    EpiEstim::estimate_R(
      incid  = inc,
      method = "parametric_si",
      config = EpiEstim::make_config(list(mean_si = si$mean, std_si = si$sd,
                                          t_start = t_start, t_end = t_end))
    ),
    warning = function(x) { warn <<- c(warn, conditionMessage(x)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
    message = function(m) invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
  )
  est <- res$R
  list(
    res = res, si = si, inc = inc, window = w,
    table = data.frame(
      window_start = res$dates[est$t_start],
      window_end   = res$dates[est$t_end],
      mean_rt      = est[["Mean(R)"]],
      median_rt    = est[["Median(R)"]],
      lower_95     = est[["Quantile.0.025(R)"]],
      upper_95     = est[["Quantile.0.975(R)"]]
    ),
    warnings = unique(warn)
  )
})

rt_box <- function(value) {
  htmltools::div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; height: 100%; width: 100%; padding: 10px;",
    htmltools::div(
      style = "font-size: 30px; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: center;font-family: var(--epiparam-font);",
      value
    )
  )
}
```

```{r rt-plot}

renderHighchart({
  r <- rt_result()
  t <- r$table
  axis_style  <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "16px", fontWeight = "bold")
  label_style <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "14px", fontWeight = "bold")
  menu_items  <- list("viewFullscreen", "separator", "downloadPNG", "downloadPDF", "downloadSVG")
  ts <- highcharter::datetime_to_timestamp(t$window_end)
  band <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(t)), function(i) list(x = ts[i], low = t$lower_95[i], high = t$upper_95[i]))
  line <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(t)), function(i) list(x = ts[i], y = t$mean_rt[i]))

  hc <- highchart() %>%
    hc_chart(style = list(fontFamily = "Jost"), backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF") %>%
    hc_title(text = "Effective Reproduction Number (Rt)",
             style = list(fontSize = "16px", fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
    hc_xAxis(type = "datetime", title = list(text = "Date (last day of window)", style = axis_style),
             labels = list(style = label_style), lineColor = "#000000", lineWidth = 1, tickColor = "#000000") %>%
    hc_yAxis(min = 0, title = list(text = "Rt", style = axis_style), labels = list(style = label_style),
             plotLines = list(list(value = 1, color = "#C0392B", width = 1.5, dashStyle = "Dash", zIndex = 5,
                                   label = list(text = "Rt = 1", align = "right",
                                                style = list(color = "#C0392B", fontWeight = "bold"))))) %>%
    hc_add_series(type = "arearange", name = "95% credible interval", data = band,
                  color = "#8B5A00", fillOpacity = 0.22, lineWidth = 0, marker = list(enabled = FALSE)) %>%
    hc_add_series(type = "line", name = "Mean Rt", data = line,
                  color = "#8B5A00", lineWidth = 2.5, marker = list(enabled = FALSE)) %>%
    hc_tooltip(shared = TRUE, valueDecimals = 2, xDateFormat = "%d %b %Y") %>%
    hc_exporting(enabled = TRUE, filename = paste0("Rt_", Sys.Date()),
                 buttons = list(contextButton = list(menuItems = menu_items)))
  hc
})
```

### Serial Interval Distribution

```{r rt-si-plot}

renderHighchart({
  r <- rt_result()
  p <- as.numeric(r$res$si_distr)
  day <- seq_along(p) - 1
  # show the distribution up to the day by which almost all of its mass has fallen
  last_day <- max(which(cumsum(p) <= 0.999)) + 1
  last_day <- min(max(last_day, 2), length(p))
  axis_style  <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "16px", fontWeight = "bold")
  label_style <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "14px", fontWeight = "bold")
  menu_items  <- list("viewFullscreen", "separator", "downloadPNG", "downloadPDF", "downloadSVG")

  highchart() %>%
    hc_chart(type = "column", style = list(fontFamily = "Jost"), backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF") %>%
    hc_title(text = "Serial Interval Used for Rt", style = list(fontSize = "16px", fontWeight = "bold")) %>%
    hc_xAxis(categories = as.character(day[seq_len(last_day)]),
             title = list(text = "Serial interval (days)", style = axis_style), labels = list(style = label_style)) %>%
    hc_yAxis(min = 0, title = list(text = "Probability", style = axis_style), labels = list(style = label_style)) %>%
    hc_plotOptions(column = list(pointPadding = 0.05, groupPadding = 0, borderWidth = 0)) %>%
    hc_add_series(type = "column", name = "Probability", data = round(p[seq_len(last_day)], 4), color = "#228B22") %>%
    hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) %>%
    hc_exporting(enabled = TRUE, filename = paste0("Serial_Interval_Used_", Sys.Date()),
                 buttons = list(contextButton = list(menuItems = menu_items)))
})
```

```{r k-and-re-data-processing}

# reactive data for k and re - filtered by selected cluster
dataset_kr <- eventReactive(input$file1_kr, {
  req(input$file1_kr)
  dataset <- read.csv(input$file1_kr$datapath)
  dataset <- data.frame(lapply(dataset, trimws))
  dataset <- janitor::clean_names(dataset)
  
  # validation start
  validate(
    need(all(c("cluster_id", "transmission_relationship") %in% names(dataset)),
         "incorrect dataset: please upload k and re data containing 'cluster id' and 'transmission relationship'.")
  )
  # validation end
  
  dataset
})

# reactive dataset filtered by selected cluster
filtered_dataset_kr <- reactive({
  req(dataset_kr(), input$cluster_kr)
  dataset <- dataset_kr()
  
  # filter data based on selected cluster
  if (input$cluster_kr != "All") {
    dataset <- dataset %>% filter(cluster_id == input$cluster_kr)
  }
  
  dataset
})

# update cluster choices when data loads
observeEvent(dataset_kr(), {
  req(dataset_kr())
  clusters <- c("All", unique(dataset_kr()$cluster_id) %>% sort())
  updateSelectInput(session, "cluster_kr", choices = clusters, selected = "All")
})

# helper function for offspring distribution - uses filtered data
get_offspring_data <- function() {
  req(filtered_dataset_kr())
  dt <- filtered_dataset_kr()
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) stop("no data available for selected cluster")
  freqt <- table(dt$source_of_infection_id) %>% data.frame() %>% filter(Var1 != 'unknown')
  zeros <- nrow(dt) - nrow(freqt)
  offt <- table(freqt$Freq) %>% data.frame()
  offtk <- c(rep(0, zeros), rep(as.numeric(levels(offt$Var1)), offt$Freq))
  list(offtk = offtk, fit = fitdistr(offtk, "negative binomial"))
}
```

### Histogram

```{r}

renderHighchart({
  
  req(input$file1_kr)
  
  res <- tryCatch({
    get_offspring_data()
  }, error = function(e) {
    NULL
  })
  
  if (is.null(res)) {
    # create empty chart with message
    highchart() %>%
      hc_title(
        text = paste("Only one record available or No data available for cluster:", input$cluster_kr), 
        style = list(
          fontSize = "20px", 
          fontWeight = "bold", 
          color = "#000000", 
          fontFamily = "Jost"
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_chart(style = list(fontFamily = "Jost"), backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF")
  } else {
    # calculate negative binomial distribution
    xvalue <- 0:max(res$offtk)
    yvalue <- dnbinom(xvalue, size = res$fit$estimate["size"], mu = res$fit$estimate["mu"])
    
    # create histogram data
    hist_data <- hist(res$offtk, plot = FALSE, breaks = seq(-0.5, max(res$offtk) + 0.5, by = 1))
    
    # create data for columns
    hist_df <- data.frame(
      from = hist_data$breaks[-length(hist_data$breaks)],
      to = hist_data$breaks[-1],
      y = hist_data$density,
      x = hist_data$mids  # For positioning reference
    )
    
    # style definitions
    axis_style <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "14px", fontWeight = "bold")
    label_style <- list(color = "#000000", fontSize = "16px", fontWeight = "Normal")
    
    # create negative binomial curve data (nudged by -0.5)
    fit_data <- data.frame(x = xvalue - 0.5, y = yvalue)
    
    highchart() %>%
      # add histogram bars
      hc_add_series(
        data = list_parse(hist_df),
        type = "column",
        name = "Histogram",
        color = "#F2F2F2",
        backgroundColor = "#FFFFFF",
        borderColor = "#000000",
        borderWidth = 1,
        groupPadding = -0.05,
        pointPadding = 0.05,
        pointRange = 1,
        pointPlacement = 0
      ) %>%
      # add negative binomial curve
      hc_add_series(
        data = fit_data,
        type = "line",
        name = "Negative Binomial Fit",
        color = "#000000",
        lineWidth = 1,
        marker = list(enabled = FALSE)
      ) %>%
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = "Offspring", style = axis_style),
        allowDecimals = FALSE,
        gridLineWidth = 0, 
        lineColor = "#000000", lineWidth = 1, tickWidth = 1, tickColor = "#000000",
        labels = list(style = label_style),
        min = -0.5,
        max = max(res$offtk) + 0.5,
        tickInterval = 1
      ) %>%
      hc_yAxis(
        title = list(text = "Density", style = axis_style),
        gridLineWidth = 0, 
        lineColor = "#000000", lineWidth = 1, tickWidth = 1, tickColor = "#000000",
        labels = list(style = label_style),
        allowDecimals = TRUE,
        min = 0
      ) %>%
      hc_title(
        text = paste("Cluster:", input$cluster_kr),
        style = list(fontSize = "16px", fontFamily = "Jost", fontWeight = "bold")
      ) %>%
      hc_tooltip(
        shared = TRUE,
        crosshairs = TRUE,
        valueDecimals = 2,
        headerFormat = "<b>Offspring: {point.x}</b><br/>",
        pointFormat = "<span style='color:#000000'>Density</span>: <b>{point.y:.2f}</b><br/>"
      ) %>%
      hc_exporting(
        enabled = TRUE,
        filename = paste0("k_ro_", input$cluster_kr),
        buttons = list(
          contextButton = list(
            menuItems = list('downloadPNG', 'downloadPDF', 'downloadSVG')
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_plotOptions(
        column = list(
          grouping = FALSE,
          pointRange = 1,
          pointPlacement = 0
        )
      ) %>%
      hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) %>%
      hc_chart(style = list(fontFamily = "Jost"))
  }
})
```

```{r parse-network-data}
filtered_data <- reactive({
  req(dataset_kr(), input$cluster_kr)
  df <- dataset_kr()
  
  # For transmission relationship, don't filter when "All" is selected
  # as we want to show specific cluster networks
  if (input$cluster_kr != "All") {
    df_filtered <- df %>% filter(cluster_id == input$cluster_kr)
  } else {
    # return empty data frame when "All" is selected

  }

network_data <- reactive({
  req(filtered_data())
  df_filtered <- filtered_data()
  
  # Check if data is empty (when "All" is selected)
  if (nrow(df_filtered) == 0) {
    return(list(nodes = data.frame(), edges = data.frame()))
  }
  
  edges_level1_2 <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster_id, infecteegen1) %>%
    unique() %>%
    rename(from = cluster_id, to = infecteegen1)
  
  edges_level2_3 <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(infecteegen1, infecteegen2) %>%
    unique() %>%
    rename(from = infecteegen1, to = infecteegen2)
  
  edges_level3_4 <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(infecteegen2, infecteegen3) %>%
    unique() %>%
    rename(from = infecteegen2, to = infecteegen3)
  
  edges_level4_5 <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(infecteegen3, infecteegen4) %>%
    unique() %>%
    rename(from = infecteegen3, to = infecteegen4)
  
  edge_list <- rbind(edges_level1_2, edges_level2_3, edges_level3_4, edges_level4_5) %>%
    filter(!from == "" & !to == "" & !is.na(from) & !is.na(to))
  
  all_nodes <- unique(c(edge_list$from, edge_list$to))
  
  node_clusters <- df_filtered %>%
    dplyr::select(id = cluster_id, cluster_id) %>%
    bind_rows(df_filtered %>% dplyr::select(id = infecteegen1, cluster_id)) %>%
    bind_rows(df_filtered %>% dplyr::select(id = infecteegen2, cluster_id)) %>%
    bind_rows(df_filtered %>% dplyr::select(id = infecteegen3, cluster_id)) %>%
    bind_rows(df_filtered %>% dplyr::select(id = infecteegen4, cluster_id)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(id), id != "") %>%
    distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  nodes <- data.frame(
    id = all_nodes,
    label = all_nodes,
    title = paste("ID:", all_nodes, "<br>Cluster:", input$cluster_kr),
    color = "#4169E1",
    font = list(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 40),
    shadow = TRUE,
    size = 25
  ) %>%
    left_join(node_clusters, by = "id") %>%
    mutate(group = ifelse(is.na(cluster_id), "Unknown", as.character(cluster_id)))
  
  list(nodes = nodes, edges = edge_list)
})

    )
})

observeEvent(input$selected_node, {
  req(input$selected_node, dataset_kr())
  selected_id <- input$selected_node$nodes[[1]]
  df <- dataset_kr()
  selected_cluster <- df %>%
    filter(cluster_id == selected_id |
             infecteegen1 == selected_id |
             infecteegen2 == selected_id |
             infecteegen3 == selected_id |
             infecteegen4 == selected_id) %>%
    pull(cluster_id) %>%
    first()
  if(!is.na(selected_cluster) && selected_cluster != input$cluster_kr) {
    updateSelectInput(session, "cluster_kr", selected = selected_cluster)
  }
})
```

```{r parse-transmission-chain}

# function to parse transmission chains
parse_transmission_chain <- function(relationship) {
  # skip if relationship is empty or unknown
  if (is.na(relationship) || relationship == "" || relationship == "unknown") {
    return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character()))
  }
  # split the chain by the arrow symbol (noticed this â†’ in the csv)
  chain <- strsplit(relationship, "→|â†’")[[1]]
  chain <- trimws(chain)  # added this cos some rows have whitespace
  
  # extract immediate relationships (each consecutive pair)
  if (length(chain) >= 2) {
    edges <- data.frame(
      from = chain[1:(length(chain) - 1)],
      to = chain[2:length(chain)]
    )
    return(edges[edges$from != "" & edges$to != "" & edges$from != edges$to, ])
  }
  
  return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character()))
}

output$download_full_network <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() { paste("full_transmission_network_", Sys.Date(), ".png", sep = "") },
  content = function(file) {
    temp_html <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
    visSave(full_network_plot(), temp_html)
    webshot2::webshot(temp_html, file, vwidth = 3600, vheight = 2800, zoom = 6, delay = 3)
  }
)

full_network_data <- reactive({
  req(dataset_kr())
  df <- dataset_kr()
  
  edges_list <- lapply(df$transmission_relationship, parse_transmission_chain)
  edges <- do.call(rbind, edges_list)
  
  edges <- edges[complete.cases(edges), ]
  edges <- unique(edges)
  
  # get all unique nodes and sort them numerically
  all_nodes <- unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
  
  # extract numeric values for sorting
  node_numbers <- as.numeric(gsub("#", "", all_nodes))
  sorted_nodes <- all_nodes[order(node_numbers)]
  
  # create nodes data frame
  nodes <- data.frame(
    id = sorted_nodes,
    label = sorted_nodes,
    title = paste("ID:", sorted_nodes),
    color = "#4169E1",
    font = list(color = "white", face = "bold", size = 50),
    shadow = TRUE,
    size = 30
  )
  
  list(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, sorted_ids = sorted_nodes)
})

output$full_network_plot <- renderVisNetwork({
  req(full_network_data())
  data <- full_network_data()
  nodes <- data$nodes
  edges <- data$edges
  sorted_ids <- data$sorted_ids
  
  if(nrow(edges) == 0) {
    nodes <- data.frame(
      id = 1,
      label = "No transmission data",
      title = "No transmission relationships found in the dataset",
      color = "#f0f0f0",
      font = list(color = "black", size = 24)
    )
    return(
      visNetwork(nodes, data.frame(from = numeric(0), to = numeric(0))) %>%
        visOptions(manipulation = FALSE) %>%
        visNodes(shape = "box", size = 50) %>%
        visLayout(randomSeed = 123)
    )
  }
  
  visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
    visEdges(
      arrows = list(to = list(enabled = TRUE, scaleFactor = 1.2)),
      color = list(color = "#6E6E6E", highlight = "#FF0000"),
      smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "dynamic")
    ) %>%
    visNodes(
      shape = "circle",
      size = 30,
      borderWidth = 1,
      borderWidthSelected = 4,
      font = list(size = 20, color = "white", face = "bold")
    ) %>%
    visOptions(
      highlightNearest = list(enabled = TRUE, degree = 1, hover = TRUE),
      nodesIdSelection = list(
        enabled = TRUE, 
        values = sorted_ids,
        style = 'width: 200px; height: 26px;'
      )
    ) %>%
    visExport(
      type = "png",
      name = paste("full_transmission_network_", Sys.Date()),
      label = "Download as PNG",
      background = "#fff",
      style = "position: absolute; top: -400px; right: 10px;",
      loadDependencies = TRUE
    ) %>%
    visInteraction(
      navigationButtons = TRUE,
      keyboard = TRUE,
      tooltipDelay = 0,
      dragView = TRUE,
      zoomView = TRUE
    ) %>%
    visLayout(
      randomSeed = 123,
      improvedLayout = TRUE
    ) %>%
    visPhysics(
      stabilization = list(iterations = 100),
      solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
      forceAtlas2Based = list(
        gravitationalConstant = -50,
        centralGravity = 0.01,
        springLength = 100,
        springConstant = 0.08
      )
    ) %>%
    visLegend(enabled = FALSE)
})
```

### Dataset Preview {.data-preview}

```{r kappa-re-data-check}
renderUI({
  d   <- filtered_dataset_kr()
  rel <- as.character(d$transmission_relationship)
  n_links <- vapply(rel, function(r) nrow(parse_transmission_chain(r)),
                    integer(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  blank <- is.na(rel) | !nzchar(trimws(rel)) | tolower(trimws(rel)) == "unknown"
  # a row with no arrow is an index case, which is normal. a row that looks like
  # it was meant to be a chain but uses some other separator is not, and used to
  # be dropped without a word.
  other_sep <- !blank & n_links == 0 &
    grepl("->|=>|>|,|;|/|\\bto\\b", rel, ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  problems <- list()
  if (any(other_sep)) {
    problems <- c(problems, list(sprintf(
      paste("%d row%s give a transmission relationship the app could not read: chains must be",
            "written with the arrow \u2192, as in \u201c#1 \u2192 #4\u201d (for example: %s)."),
      sum(other_sep), if (sum(other_sep) == 1) "" else "s",
      paste0("\u201c", utils::head(unique(rel[other_sep]), 3), "\u201d", collapse = ", "))))
  }
  if (any(blank)) {
    problems <- c(problems, list(sprintf(
      "%d row%s have no transmission relationship, and contribute no link.",
      sum(blank), if (sum(blank) == 1) "" else "s")))
  }
  data_check_panel(
    n_read = nrow(d),
    n_used = sum(n_links > 0),
    problems = problems,
    used_label = "with an onward transmission link",
    out_label  = "index cases with none"
  )
})
```
